title: CERN and Mistral Build Large Physics Model From Billions of Collisions
summary:
Mistral and CERN are collaborating to determine how artificial intelligence can assist in managing the intricacies of particle physics. The partnership aims to develop a single Large Physics Model by training it on billions of simulated collisions to address the increasing complexity of data produced in high-energy experiments.

The project reflects a growing trend of applying large scale machine learning to experimental physics to identify patterns in massive datasets. Researchers in the field have highlighted AI for experimental physics as a rapidly accelerating area of study.
